title: Unify versioned intake and preserve online/offline laboratory drafts
body:
Canonical versioned intake replaces contradictory receipt/acceptance paths. Reception, consignments, legacy acceptance and existing offline RECORD_INTAKE share current scope/admission checks, immutable form selection and one atomic facts/work/audit/receipt transaction. Saved revisions and actual source/custody/observations survive default changes and retries; physical receipt does not create analytical work.

Own-lab managers can select published forms and toggle catalogue requirements; project bindings also require project-plan authority. The UI reports device-only versus server-confirmed persistence, preserves owned local drafts, displays recorded history and adds five-language, responsive controls.

Validation:25 new contracts; relevant existing reception/admission/package/profile/offline/shared-device contracts; actual40-row consignment; production client build; additive migration twice on a disposable38,566-sample copy with counts/integrity/FKs preserved; local browser manager-save, offline recovery, five languages and320px layout. Details and limitations: WP/profile-and-intake-issues-140-156-v2/ACCEPTANCE-EVIDENCE-B1.md.

Independent exact-head review and CI are release gates. This is B1 initial delivery for #156; B2 custom criteria/context editor and explicit draft upgrades remain required. No automatic issue closure or claimed physical-device/receiver acceptance.

title: feat(theme): implement approved SoilFER signature visual refresh
body:
## Summary

Implements the approved **SoilFER signature visual refresh** across the signed-in application, grounded in the approved mockups from `WP/soil-lab-visual-identity-v1`.

### Key Enhancements:
- **Forest-Green Navigation**: Primary sidebar (`#173F32` in light, `#243932` in dark) with white/light logo contrast, clear active states (`#305C49` with primary accent indicator), and decorative bottom soil-band graphic (`aria-hidden="true"`).
- **Warm Surfaces & Refined Palette**:
  - Warm limestone background (`#F5F3ED`) paired with crisp white analytical work surfaces (`#FFFFFF`).
  - Terracotta method accents (`#945539`), restrained ochre instructions box (`#85601B`), and mineral-blue supporting badges (`#206477`).
  - Sleek graphite dark mode (`#25282B` canvas, `#2E3236` surfaces) without near-black pitch or leftover white controls.
- **Laboratory Record Label Styling**:
  - Sample identifiers styled with laboratory record badges (`.sf-sample-id`).
  - Analytical worksheets enhanced with method banners, clear tabular numerals, and docked inspector readiness checklists.
  - Sample Detail view upgraded with multi-band brand rule, 4-column material metadata grid, next action callouts, and clean 5-tab navigation.
- **Paper Integrity & Print Preservation**:
  - White-paper overrides retained for certificates, printed reports, and thermal barcode labels (`.sf-paper`, `[data-surface="paper"]`, and `@media print`).

### Functional Boundary:
- 100% preservation of all 5 locales (`en`, `es`, `es-419`, `fr`, `pt`).
- 0 database migrations, 0 schema changes, 0 API route changes, 0 business logic changes.
- 85/85 Jest test suites passing (607/607 tests). Client Vite build passing cleanly (0 errors).
